learned_patterns.pattern: The fractional stop monitor works end-to-end: INTC's -12.6% ATR stop fired 7/7 as an agentic auto-sell off main's fractional_positions.json, filling at $109.01 (-14.96%). Second monitor-enforced stop-out after MRVL. Fractional stops are LIVE even when session memory/site prose is frozen on an unmerged branch — the monitor reads main directly.

Reconcile ORDERS, not just positions, after any gap between sessions. Memory was 12 days stale; only get_equity_orders revealed the INTC exit and explained the $0.37 -> $11.37 cash as sale proceeds (not a deposit). §17 explicitly excludes just-sold cash from deposit routing — never infer a deposit from a cash rise without checking for an intervening sell.

INTC round-tripped from a strong 6/30 print (+8.8%, near the +15% SOXX-migration trigger) to a -14.96% stop-out within a week. A name can travel from near-migration to stopped-out in days; the tight ATR stop capped the loss near -13% as intended. Don't anchor to a prior session's unrealized high.

LAB self-corrects under its cap via exits, not only base growth: the INTC stop-out pulled LAB 25.9% -> 18.0% in one exit, reopening entry capacity that was blocked over-cap on 6/30. §17.3 forbids force-selling to rebalance, but organic stop-outs achieve the same de-risking and reopen the entry gate.
